root_cause: The page-global onChatIdbWrite hook also fires for Alice's own 'accepted' invite_lifecycle announcement (authored when Bob's join profile reaches her, ~265ms after the user message). Not a duplicate of the own message; intended product behaviour. Separately the spec's getFirstMessageId picked the first msg-* bubble, which is the 'invited' announcement, so sharedMessageId was wrong and the row/bubble assertions were vacuous.
fix: Spec: hook now records {groupId,messageId} into window.__chatIdbWrites; own-send test selects the bubble by unique text (getMessageIdByText), asserts exactly one row with the sent content (catches second-id duplicates), id==sharedMessageId, one row by id, one bubble, and exactly one hook write for that messageId. Removed dead installChatIdbWriteCounter/getChatIdbWriteCount. Comments corrected. ChatStoreContext header corrected (it claimed an applicationMessage handler that no longer exists).
tests_added: strengthened own-send e2e (sent-content row uniqueness + id-filtered write assertion)
